items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you play some with Orey? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. Played with Dutrey.

ctx.x: Tuba. I hadn't started on string bass yet. Tiny played piano. I'm trying to remember who played drums on that. Preston Jackson, I think, may have been on trombone. I don't remember whether Dutrey or Kid Ory was in on them records or not. Because they were doing a lot of recording with the same bands.
Did you play some with Orey?
